title: Tribhanga Pose
content: Tribhangais a classic stance in Indian sculpture that emphasizes the flowing, sensual line of the figure.Like thecontrappostopose of European sculpture, it involves an uneven distribution of weight and a shifting of the axis through the pose.Tribhangaliterally means 'three parts break,' the breaks being in the neck, the waist, and the knee, giving the pose a gentle "S" movement.---Tribhangaon WikipediaRecommended books:The Theory of Citrasutras in Indian PaintingElements of Hindu Iconography
